title: Automatic door unlock and walk-away locking behavior
summary: The topic centers on proximity-based door unlocking, walk-away locking, and related door access behavior, with most examples being descriptive reports rather than clearly evaluative feedback.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the vehicle’s greeting behavior with lights activating as the customer walks past.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe automatic unlocking, locking, and door-access settings in mixed contexts including normal operation, unwanted garage triggering, changed behavior, and explanations of configuration.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment conclusions are limited.
Several undetermined examples contain issue-like wording, but their assigned sentiment is not negative, so they cannot be summarized as negative feedback.
The cluster combines normal feature behavior, configuration guidance, and possible malfunction descriptions, which limits a single coherent interpretation.
